summary: Research Alliance Corp III filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, announcing the effectiveness of its S-1 for an initial public offering. The SPAC entered into an underwriting agreement with Leerink Partners, an investment management trust agreement with Continental Stock Transfer, a registration rights agreement with the sponsor, indemnity agreements, a letter agreement with sponsor and officers to vote for an initial business combination within 24 months, and a private placement shares purchase agreement. The filing outlines standard SPAC IPO mechanics with a trust account and 24-month deadline. Watch for de-SPAC transaction announcement or liquidation risk if no deal is found.
